open_points.subject: flow:author_and_admit_function / Step 2 disclosure class for TrialCase StoredValues
open_points.text: State 3: "functions for trial outputs (the highest class of the case's inputs)." vs State 4 Step 2: "module:functions writes their StoredValues, each with the class the input port declares (A07 rule 3)"
open_points.question: When an authored trial case includes expected outputs, what disclosure_class must be stored on those expected-output StoredValues?
options: Use the highest class among the case inputs (as State 3 says for trial outputs).
Use a class taken from the related output port (though contract output ports declare no class).
Refuse expected outputs because their class cannot be derived.
open_points.default_guess: Use the highest class among the case inputs.

open_points.subject: flow:start_and_recover_kernel / Step 6 recovery of in-flight effects
open_points.text: State 2 A11 rule 1: "A crash between those two calls is the `in_flight` case of rule 4, whose recovery also marks that approval `used`." vs State 4 Step 6: "every `in_flight` attempt becomes `unknown`, and when its attempt has no NodeExecution yet the `outcome_unknown` record is written ..."
open_points.question: During `effects.recover_in_flight_attempts`, must the approval tied to the in-flight attempt also be transitioned to `used`?
options: Yes, always mark the linked approval `used` during this recovery path.
No, leave the approval unchanged (for example `approved`) while only changing the attempt to `unknown`.
